cases.query: WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * FROM STREAM(x)
WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS id), y AS (SELECT * FROM STREAM(x)) SELECT * FROM STREAM(y)
WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * FROM (WITH x AS (SELECT 2 AS id) SELECT * FROM STREAM(x))
WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * FROM (WITH x AS (SELECT 2 AS id) SELECT * FROM STREAM(x)) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM STREAM(x)
